shortDescription: True fans show their subscription receipts and skip the line — Wildcard fast-track signup for Kimi Talk events
longDescription: Browse upcoming Kimi Talk and official community offline events and sign up in a conversation. Eligible members, including gifted memberships, can authorize extraction of their current plan and subscription expiry plus a cropped screenshot of that area for Wildcard fast-track verification. Other users join the standard review queue. Wildcard is a generic event-signup tiering brand; this plugin is the Kimi edition.
tryPrompts: Show me upcoming Kimi Talk events
I want to sign up for the Shenzhen Kimi Talk
I have a Wildcard — use fast-track verification for my signup

wildcard-for-kimi.description: Browse and sign up for Kimi Talk events; eligible members get Wildcard fast-track verification via their current plan and subscription expiry
